restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access by non-standard processes, use of credential-dumping tools (e.g., Mimikatz, procdump on lsass), SAM/NTDS.dit or registry hive reads, DPAPI/credential vault access, or suspicious authentication with harvested credentials.
what_would_refute: No LSASS access, no credential-dumping tool execution, no SAM/NTDS.dit or registry hive reads, and no anomalous credential use across the Windows hosts.
